name: Hoshizaki Mikage
source: Though still young and inexperienced, she is a gentle teacher with a kind demeanor who conducts her classes carefully. However, she holds the belief that "physical punishment leads to improved academic performance and correction of character and attitude," and so she torments students with poor grades without any ill intent. She also believes that the students she disciplines are actually enjoying it.
